flags.title: Sector tailwind
flags.note: Consumer Durables is in a TAILWIND (tailwind score +0.83) — the macro backdrop supports the setup.
flags.lesson: Focus on cycles and change, not insider chatter (the author's actual edge).

flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

opportunities.point: Management stated confidence in performing better in the upcoming financial year 2023-24 due to opening new branches and franchisees.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "As we set our sights on the future, we are confident in our ability to perform even better in the upcoming financial year 2023-24. Several reasons underpin our optimism: a) Opening new branches and franchisees in the coming year will contribute to improved..." (annual report - 2023-03-31)

opportunities.point: During FY 2024-25, the company strengthened its presence in Bilaspur, expanding its market share and introducing exclusive new collections.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "During FY 2024–25, we further strengthened our presence in Bilaspur, expanding our market share and introducing exclusive new collections." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: P/E is cheaper than the sector median.
P/B is cheaper than the sector median.
A consumer durables tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Management noted that global demand for ethically sourced and certified natural diamonds remains robust.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "As global demand for ethically sourced and certified natural diamonds remains robust, we see an opportunity to reinforce our position as a trusted destination for fine jewellery." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: The company responded to strong regional demand and customer loyalty by increasing its market size in Bilaspur.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "We have increased our market size in Bilaspur, responding to strong regional demand and customer loyalty." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: Eighty Jewellers manages franchisee stores and owns and operates one franchisee store and one retail outlet.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "In addition to managing franchisee stores, Eighty Jewellers owns and operates one franchisee store and one retail outlet." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

opportunities.point: The company has not declared any dividend during the year under audit.
opportunities.evidence: Capital allocation: "The company has not declared any dividend during the year under audit." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

opportunities.point: Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the year ended March 31, 2023, in order to plough back profits and keep funds for future requirements.
opportunities.evidence: Capital allocation: "Keeping in view the requirement of the funds in future, your Directors have not recommended any dividend for the year ended 31st March, 2023." (annual report - 2023-03-31)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.

Management stated that the fiscal year 2023-24 presented a complex economic landscape characterized by global and domestic economic trends such as inflation, interest rates, and geopolitical tensions.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The year 2023-24 presented a complex economic landscape characterized by global and domestic economic trends, such as inflation, interest rates, geopolitical tensions." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

swot.verdict: No quadrant dominates - strengths, opportunities carry equal weight (S20/W5/O20/T9), so the evidence does not favour one side.
